paragraphs: BarkPass sells software for pet licensing and dog park management, aimed at local governments and at private operators of dog parks. The company describes one system meant to raise revenue, improve safety and connect an agency with its community.

On the government side, cities and counties use it to recover licensing revenue that would otherwise go uncollected and to secure public dog parks. Residents handle their own licensing through a self-service experience. The site also offers a pet licensing calculator.

Private parks are the second market for the same product. Dog bars, homeowner associations and nonprofit parks use it to launch and run membership-based parks with little overhead. The business operates as BarkPass LLC.
